name: pi-context-cap
notes: Forked from lukeramsden/pi-context-cap (npm @lukeramsden/pi-context-cap v1.0.1). Local divergence per openspec change fork-pi-context-cap: (1) npm renamed to @xzzpig/pi-context-cap, fork version 0.1.0; (2) added config file support (global context-cap.json + project .pi/context-cap.json, key-level merge, project trusted guard) with models whitelist (minimatch provider/modelId or bare modelId), budget/reserve from config; (3) session tri-state override /context-cap on|off (default follows whitelist); (4) refactored core into config.ts/whitelist.ts modules; README fork notice + CHANGELOG 0.1.0 fork entry.
